meta.title: About Innerleaps: our mission and accredited trainers
meta.description: Innerleaps was founded by Bas Ter Haar Romenij to prevent burnout before it escalates. Our accredited trainers work with one proven method. No variation just consistent results.

hero.title: “How do you get <0>so much</0> done?”
hero.subtitle: The answer? We now teach it to organisations that never slow down.

body: I always worked hard, and I noticed that small things threw me off balance quickly. My reflex was often to work even harder. But my body figured out what that was doing to me before my head did.

Then I came across MBSR, a stress management course. The result surprised me: I wasn't just calmer, I was much sharper and more effective too. My whole product team noticed. I validated our new product after 3 pivots and onboarded the first 30 customers. My team asked me: “How do you get so much done?”
I wanted every team to have that. When my role was made redundant, I took the chance and started Innerleaps.

belief.title: Your best work doesn't come from your <0>longest</0> days
belief.body: When work never stops, you get used to a full calendar fast. Meeting after meeting, priorities that change halfway, messages until late. So you think: work even harder. I thought so too. But a tense mind makes more mistakes and gets less done. Focus makes the difference. And focus is something you can simply train.

mission.title: For the people who <0>never</0> have time for this
mission.body: MBSR turned out to be too much for most companies. So together with our accredited trainers, I developed a lighter version: 6 weeks of 1 hour a week in a small group, plus 15 minutes of practice every day. Our goal? Train 10,000 people, and make the world a little better along the way.
mission.imageAlt: Bas ter Haar Romenij giving a presentation on vitality and stress management at Innerleaps

wineke.body: Before she became a trainer, Wineke spent 17 years in business as a project manager, consultant and communications adviser. She has now been training teams for 15 years. Participants call her practical and down to earth.

dave.body: Dave was an editor and content manager for 15 years. He has been a trainer for 8 years now, mostly in government, healthcare and education. He shares his own experiences, which makes it easy for others to join in.

anne.body: Anne worked in marketing and communications at BAT and Ziggo for 15 years. She has been a trainer for 8 years. She explains things without jargon, and participants feel she really understands them.

jacqueline.body: Jacqueline ran her own IT company and worked as an HR manager and as a manager in healthcare. She has been a trainer since 2017. She always links the theory to what you are going through yourself.
